text:
anya: Heads up — hitting a vector dim mismatch when using the Go batcher + rerank helper. Embeddings from model `rwkv-embed-2` are coming back as 1536 but our DB + reranker expect 1024. Minimal repro below, anyone seen this before?

anya: ```go
vecs, err := client.Embeddings(ctx, &sdk.EmbedRequest{Model: "rwkv-embed-2", Input: texts})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
// vecs[0].Len() == 1536 but we assume 1024 elsewhere
```

raj: which SDK version? we had a patch last week that changed default model mapping for the Go client. did you pin a model override?

anya: running go-sdk v0.9.1 — not pinning model mapping explicitly (rely on helper). logs show `model: rwkv-embed-2` and then downstream panic at `IndexInsert` due to len != expectedDim.

ben: we merged a change to the batcher that enables streaming embedding chunks — aggregator assumed fixed dim and concatenated chunks. if chunk sizes vary, final length might be > expected.

sarah: can you paste the raw response shape? sometimes the client returns multiple chunked vectors as separate slices. a short defensive check helps: `if len(vec) != cfg.EmbeddingDim { return ErrDimMismatch }`

kevin: workaround: add a validation step right after receiving embeddings and before persisting. Also consider a conversion/compression step (PCA) if model dims changed intentionally. But if this is unintentional, patch the aggregator.

ben: confirming — streaming path in go-batcher incorrectly treats each chunk as a full vector when the server streams partial dot-rows. I'll open a patch. For now, you can force non-streaming call by setting `Stream: false` in the helper.

anya: thanks. quick diagnostic I ran: `len(vecs[0]) == 1536`, `expectedDim == 1024`. Model catalog on prod lists rwkv-embed-2 as 1536 (weird). maybe catalog mismatch.

raj: catalog sync is plausible. infra recently promoted a model alias change. @infra-bot any recent model-catalog pushes?

infra-bot: model-catalog:deploy succeeded by @deploy-octo at 2026-03-15T08:23Z — promoted aliases: {"rwkv-embed-2": "rwkv-embed-2-1536"}.

anya: ah, that explains it. our reranker pipeline still expects older 1024 variant. I'll either pin model to `rwkv-embed-2-1024` or change pipeline to accept 1536.

ben: PR incoming for aggregator fix (no chunk-as-full-vector). small unit tests too. https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/482

sarah: sample safe-guard to add to helper (copy/paste):
```go
expected := cfg.EmbeddingDim
for i, v := range vecs {
  if len(v) != expected {
    return fmt.Errorf("embedding dim mismatch at index %d: got %d want %d", i, len(v), expected)
  }
}
```

anya: adding that + test in our repo, and will pin model on prod until ben's patch rolls. pinging @ben @raj for quick code review once PR is open.

raj: will review after lunch.

ben: thanks. also logging a note re: streaming quirks in the SDK docs (small paragraph) so folks don't get surprised by alias promos.

anya: great — will follow up here when we've toggled the fallback. :+1:
